field.label: SMS provider
field.comment: Who sends text messages. With one provider installed it is used automatically.

field.label: WhatsApp provider
field.comment: Who sends WhatsApp messages. With one provider installed it is used automatically.

field.label: Viber provider
field.comment: Who sends Viber messages. With one provider installed it is used automatically.

group.label: Infobip
group.comment: Text, WhatsApp and Viber messages through Infobip, one account per website. Each message asks Infobip for its delivery report. In Infobip, forward the messages to your senders (inbound, "Forward to HTTP", JSON) to the URLs shown below - they carry a token made from the webhook secret. Turn Infobip's channel failover off: a message must stay on its channel. One provider module per channel: with another one installed for the same channel, its quiet hours zones and opt-in confirmation may apply instead.

field.label: API base URL
field.comment: Your account's base URL from the Infobip portal, e.g. https://xxxxx.api.infobip.com.

field.label: API key
field.comment: Stored encrypted. Give it the messaging scopes only.

field.label: SMS sender
field.comment: A number in international format or an alphanumeric sender ID, as registered with Infobip.

field.label: WhatsApp sender
field.comment: The WhatsApp business number registered with Infobip, in international format.

field.label: Viber sender
field.comment: The Viber business sender name registered with Infobip.

field.label: Webhook secret
field.comment: A long random value of your choice; stored encrypted. Infobip signs no webhook, so their URLs carry a token made from it: without a secret every webhook is refused. Changing it retires the URLs in Infobip - enter the new ones.

field.label: Public URL
field.comment: The shop's public HTTPS address as Infobip calls it, e.g. https://shop.example. Empty: the store's secure base URL.

field.label: Opt-in confirmation
field.comment: One message to a number's first sign-up in the website, as US carriers require, when Infobip is the channel's provider. A new cart of the same number gets none.

field.label: Opt-in confirmation text
field.comment: For SMS and Viber; {{store}} is the store's name. WhatsApp sends a template instead: map "infobip_optin" below (variable "store").

field.label: WhatsApp templates
field.comment: Per notification type (e.g. infobip_optin, or your own WhatsApp notification type) and locale (e.g. de_DE, de, or empty for any): the approved template's name and language in Infobip, and the notification's variables for {{1}}, {{2}}, … (e.g. store for infobip_optin).
